ingredients.raw: 1 pound asparagus (the thickest stalks you can find), bottom 2 inches trimmed off, stalks cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
ingredients.name: asparagus

ingredients.raw: 1 tablespoon fresh minced oregano leaves or 1 teaspoon dried oregano
ingredients.name: fresh oregano

ingredients.raw: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: kosher salt and black pepper

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese (ideally Parmigiano Reggiano), divided
ingredients.name: parmesan cheese

ingredients.raw: Optional: store-bought pesto or burrata, to serve
ingredients.name: pesto or burrata (optional)

instructions.text: Trim two inches off the bottom of the asparagus, then cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Thinly slice the shallot.

Add the asparagus and shallot to your largest rimmed sheet pan along with the gnocchi (no need to cook it first), pancetta, olive oil, oregano, 1 teaspoon kosher salt, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, and garlic powder. Use a microplane to grate the garlic cloves and lemon zest on top.
Use your hands to toss and evenly coat everything. If any gnocchi feels dry, add a little more olive oil.
Place on the center rack and roast for 25 minutes, stirring once at the 15-minute mark.
Taste and add more salt as needed (pancettas vary in saltiness).
Add 1/4 cup grated Parmesan to the sheet pan and stir until incorporated. Serve with the rest of the Parmesan sprinkled on top.
